create-table-references: The new queue table references the handful-row corpus_index_generations registry; its SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE is a catalog change taken under the mutation fence with a one-second lock bound.
row-level-security: Enabling and forcing row security on the table created in this migration touches no existing relation.
create-policy: The policies are created on the table created in this migration, which no other session can reach yet.
create-trigger: Both row triggers on the revision table are created under the mutation fence with a one-second lock bound, so projection writers are already held, readers are not blocked, and no stored row is read or rewritten.
